functions.arguments: val text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _platform.slugify(val text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN lower(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        unaccent(trim(val)),
        '[^a-zA-Z0-9\s-]', '', 'g'
      ),
      '[\s-]+', '-', 'g'
    )
  );
END;
$function$

functions.name: localized_items_max
functions.arguments: v jsonb, n integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _supatype.localized_items_max(v jsonb, n integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT bool_and(jsonb_array_length(value::jsonb) <= n) FROM jsonb_each_text(v)
$function$

functions.body:
SELECT coalesce(string_agg(t, ''), '')
  FROM jsonb_path_query(v, 'strict $.**.text ? (@.type() == "string")') AS q(j),
       LATERAL (SELECT j #>> '{}') AS s(t)
functions.arguments: v jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _supatype.richtext_text(v jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(string_agg(t, ''), '')
  FROM jsonb_path_query(v, 'strict $.**.text ? (@.type() == "string")') AS q(j),
       LATERAL (SELECT j #>> '{}') AS s(t)
$function$
